text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH_SEV - continuous-batcher KV cache growth / perf cliff detected in us-west-2. Alerting on-call. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1795004321 :rotating_light:

caleb_oncall: Seeing sudden sustained increase in 95th pct latency on cont-batch workers. Token RT up from ~40ms to >800ms. Autoscaler pressure also high.

caleb_oncall: Stack of signs: KV cache size slowly climbs, then continuous batching latencies spike, CPU pinned on host. Noticing large number of small batches with huge max_batch_tokens config during a deploy.

maria_sre: copying — which deploy? any recent rollout to cont-batch?

caleb_oncall: josh rolled a runtime config change ~20m ago. Possibly changed default max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 65536 (typo).

josh_prod: yup that was me, trying to increase to reduce RPCs. I tested locally but missed prod override. Sorry.

kevin_infra: If max_batch_tokens is that high we'll create enormous KV cache per sequence when continuous batching fills. That matches the cache blowup we see.

nora_support: Customer impact? any customer-facing errors?

caleb_oncall: We have increased tail latency and some 504s for realtime endpoints in us-west-2. A few high-throughput customers reported degraded performance (customers: acme-marketing, dataforge). Estimated 8% of requests affected in the last 15m.

maria_sre: severity? I think Sev2 due to partial customer impact and degraded SLOs.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1795004321. Severity: P2. Channel: #incidents.

caleb_oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert the prod config to previous max_batch_tokens 2048 2) temporarily disable KV prefix caching for cont-batch 3) restart the smallest affected pool nodes gracefully to reclaim memory.

emma_eng: I can patch the config; rolling revert + canary. Suggest we patch via /admin/rollouts, not full restart first.

kevin_infra: Patch command (internal):
```bash
# update runtime config for cont-batcher in us-west-2
redwoodctl config set cont-batcher.us-west-2.max_batch_tokens=2048 --env=prod
redwoodctl config set cont-batcher.us-west-2.max_num_seqs=8 --env=prod
```

caleb_oncall: Also set max_num_seqs lower as a safety net to avoid giant fused batches. Let's do max_num_seqs=8 as kevin suggested.

josh_prod: Rolling the config now. Pushing to canary 10% of nodes. Watching metrics.

caleb_oncall: Observability commands:
```text
# check cont-batch kv cache size histogram
curl -s https://metrics.redwood/api/query?metric=cont_batch_kv_cache_size&region=us-west-2 | jq .
# check tail latency
curl -s https://metrics.redwood/api/query?metric=cont_batch_95p_latency&region=us-west-2 | jq .
```

(15:22) josh_prod: Canary applied to 12 nodes. KV cache growth stopped on those nodes. 95p latency dropped from ~820ms -> ~60ms on canary group.

(15:28) emma_eng: Rolling to 100% in us-west-2 now.

(15:31) kevin_infra: Also disabling prefix KV caching for cont-batch as temporary mitigation (will re-enable once we confirm stability):
```bash
redwoodctl feature toggle cont-batch.kv_prefix_cache --off --region=us-west-2 --env=prod
```

(15:37) caleb_oncall: After full rollout: 95p latency back to normal (~55-75ms). Memory pressure reduced across hosts. Error rate normalized. No new 504s observed since ~15:34.

nora_support: Notifying affected customers (acme-marketing, dataforge) with initial incident memo and ETA for full postmortem.

josh_prod: root cause: operator error during config change (typo-induced large max_batch_tokens) combined with continuous batching heuristic that allowed large fused batches when max_batch_tokens large. We need config validation to prevent absurd values.

emma_eng: Action items:
- hotfix: add config bounds check for max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs (PR 2321)
- postmortem + RCA (owner: maria_sre)
- add alerting that correlates KV cache growth and config changes
- runbook update for cont-batch misconfig incidents

maria_sre: I'll take ownership of the postmortem. Timeline: initial draft within 48h.

caleb_oncall: Handoff: I'm leaving shift at 16:00. @maria_sre taking on-call for follow-up.

maria_sre: taking over. Thanks @caleb_oncall :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1795004321 updated: status -> mitigated.

nora_support: Customers have been notified with mitigation note + apology. CS escalations opened for two accounts.

kevin_infra: Quick note for postmortem: also check autoscaler config — large batch tokens can make autoscaler think nodes are healthy while memory is consumed by KV caches. Might need memory-based autoscaler triggers.

josh_prod: sorry again, I'll follow up on the PR and add unit tests for config boundaries.

maria_sre: Recording timeline/events in incident doc. Will include exact metrics, config diffs and commands used for rollback.

caleb_oncall: Closing loop: mitigation completed, impact window ~15:06 - 15:34 UTC (28 minutes).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1795004321 closed (status: mitigated). Postmortem assigned to maria_sre.

maria_sre: creating postmortem doc and linking it here when ready.

emma_eng: small follow-up — consider a conservative default for max_batch_tokens in templates and fail-fast validation on nonsensical config values.

nora_support: Adding customer follow-ups and monitoring for regressions.

caleb_oncall: Thanks all. Good catch and fast rollout.

josh_prod: lesson learned: always review prod overrides twice.

maria_sre: end of thread.
